
══════════════════════════════════════════
  HUNT: Named Pipe C2 / Lateral Movement
══════════════════════════════════════════

  VERDICT     HIGH CONFIDENCE C2 PIPE / LATERAL MOVEMENT — handle-confirmed pipe with BOTH nearby C2 context and live RIP/EIP execution
  Confidence  high
  Score       3/3  (handle-anchored; bare pipe strings are unscored leads)
  Coverage    PARTIAL
  Review      high

  KEY SIGNALS

  [!] DETECTION  Handle-confirmed pipe corroborated by memory evidence
      1 open pipe handle(s) are corroborated by C2-style context and/or live RIP/EIP execution
      within ±4096 bytes of a matching pipe-name string's own address.

  [!] DETECTION  Known C2 framework pipe naming convention on an open handle
      1 open pipe handle(s) match a known C2/lateral-movement framework naming convention.

  [i] CONTEXT    Open pipe handles (HandleDataStream)
      Process holds 1 open handle(s) to named pipe object(s), per HandleDataStream.

  [~] LEAD       Pipe name strings in non-system memory
      1 occurrence(s) of a '\pipe\' name found in non-system-DLL memory via byte-pattern scan.

  WHY THIS VERDICT

  Inference
    1 open pipe handle(s) are corroborated by C2-style context and/or live RIP/EIP execution within
    ±4096 bytes of a matching pipe-name string's own address.

  Confidence: HIGH
    Combines an OS-confirmed open handle with BOTH independent memory signals (C2 artifacts AND live
    execution), both within 4096 bytes of that pipe's name string — the strongest correlation this
    hunter can produce.

  Caveat
    Name correlation between a handle's ObjectName and a string scan hit uses exact match on the
    canonicalized pipe name (prefix stripped, casefolded) — still not a cryptographic guarantee both
    refer to the identical kernel object if the process has multiple same-named pipe instances.

  COVERAGE

  [~] PARTIAL
      1 region(s) returned fewer bytes than declared (short read) — not fully scanned:
      0x0000000001230000 (4 KB)
      Impact: A pipe name or C2 artifact in memory that was never read cannot be ruled out —
      targeted follow-up needed on the region(s) above: --extract / --strings that VA, or re-scan it
      with an external scanner.
      Impact: Coverage incomplete despite a detection — additional pipe channels may exist beyond
      what could be checked.

  Use --verbose for the full handle list, canonicalized pipe names, VA/file offsets, and nearby C2 context.
